ChildMinutesLst.Title: a. C&I Update
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes:
Dr. LeMay shared information on additions to Real World Learning (RWL) shared pathways, and a client centered project with the City of Grandview.

Dr. Rodrequez introduced Eric Wollerman, President, Contractor for the Department of Energy’s Kansas City National Security Campus (KSNSC), Managed and Operated by Honeywell, who spoke about the partnership KSNSC has with the district and the opportunities being provided to students.
